title: AI Demand Monitor — hyperscaler capex, contracted backlog and AI-lab commitments
note: Demand side of the AI buildout: what the buyers of capacity disclose. Canonical source for ai-demand-monitor.{md,html}. $B unless noted. Every row carries the date it was disclosed (as_of) and a primary source; sourcing='secondary' marks figures supported only by press accounts. Derived series (q/q, trailing-4Q, run-rate, guide midpoints and revisions, capex-per-contracted-GW) are computed at render time by the refresh script and the HTML from the same formulas, never stored. Research, not P&L. Does not duplicate the neocloud capacity tracker — capacity_crosscheck is read from neocloud-capacity.json at sync time.
sources_note: Cash capex is FMP statements/cashflow-statement 'investmentsInPropertyPlantAndEquipment' (sign flipped), pulled 2026-10-25. Cross-checks: the five hyperscalers' quarterly figures and closed-year sums against their releases; CRWV against its 10-Q/10-K (H1 2025, 9M 2025, FY2025, H1 2026 cash paid for P&E); NBIS against the capex stated in its shareholder letters. Guide quotes, finance leases, RPO and contracted figures are from the linked releases and filings; guides whose quote comes from the call carry a guide.src and were checked against the FMP earningsTranscript text. Lab-register sizes marked primary link a company, lab or SEC source; secondary rows link the press report (press_src). Perplexity research (2026-10-25/26) located the sources; it is not cited as a source.

basis.qoq: capex[q] / capex[q-1] - 1 (within a company's own series)
basis.ttm: sum of the company's latest four reported quarters of capex (null until four exist)
basis.run_rate: latest reported quarter × 4, per company; the cohort run-rate sums the five hyperscalers' latest quarters, whose period-ends differ (the page prints the span)
basis.guide_mid: (low + high) / 2 when both are numbers; a single number is its own midpoint; qualitative guides have no midpoint
basis.guide_revision: per company and guide fiscal year, the ordered guide midpoints by call date; implied and carried points are shown but revision = last stated − first stated full-year guide; vs_actual = actual − last stated guide once fy_actual is recorded
basis.capex_per_contracted_gw: hyperscaler cohort run-rate ($B/yr) ÷ de-duplicated tenant-disclosed contracted neocloud MW (GW) from neocloud-capacity.json. Scale context only: hyperscaler payments to neoclouds are mostly service fees or leases, not cash P&E, and the tenant list includes non-hyperscaler tenants. Not a forecast.
basis.latest_guide_move: last stated full-year guide midpoint − the previous stated midpoint for the same fiscal year (null when only one exists)
